key_patterns: THREE payment providers each with a signature-verified, idempotent webhook handler. Stripe idempotency = acquireLock('stripe:evt:{id}', 24h). Razorpay idempotency = acquireLock('razorpay:evt:{id}', 24h TTL). PayU idempotency = per-txnid inside a single DB transaction (checks invoice_payments.reference == txnid). Money stored as Postgres decimal (strings); lib/money.ts + lib/billing/payments.ts round to cents at each step. Invoice numbers: MAX(sequence) + FOR UPDATE tenant lock + unique-constraint retry (#1462). Dunning: cap counts ALL non-succeeded attempts, attemptNumber = MAX+1, subscription row locked (#1464). Stripe status map is an explicit switch with fail-safe default=past_due (#1463) plus a terminal-status guard.

key_findings_and_risks: An automated Stripe TEST-mode harness ALREADY EXISTS for #1477 (scripts/billing-lifecycle-test.ts, run via npm run test:billing) with a runbook at docs/billing-lifecycle-test.md. It covers: checkout->active, idempotency (duplicate->{duplicate:true}), invoice numbering #1462, dunning cap #1464, Stripe status map #1463, terminal-status guard, cancellation->free, missing-metadata guard. The new plan MUST reference and build on this, not duplicate it, and must ADD the Razorpay + PayU coverage the existing docs explicitly leave as follow-up (docs section 9).

GAP: Razorpay and PayU have NO end-to-end/automated lifecycle harness; only unit tests (tests/unit/razorpay.test.ts, tests/unit/payu.test.ts) exist for signature/hash logic. These need MANUAL test-mode steps in the plan.

OBSERVATION (report, do not fix): Razorpay handler returns HTTP 200 even when a handler throws (to stop Razorpay retries), whereas Stripe returns 500 to force retry. Different reliability semantics across providers — call out in plan as a verification nuance.

OBSERVATION (report, do not fix): #1462 invoice numbering is gap-safe against DELETE because DELETE is a SOFT delete (deletedAt) and MAX() derives from surviving max sequence; a hard delete of the highest row WOULD reuse a number, but the code path only soft-deletes. Plan should verify soft-delete behavior explicitly.

OBSERVATION (report, do not fix): Stripe cancellation (customer.subscription.deleted) sets status='active' + planId='free' (deliberate downgrade-not-suspend), while Razorpay subscription.cancelled sets status='cancelled' + planId='free'. Divergent tenant.status outcome across providers for 'cancellation' — the plan's cancellation section must state each provider's expected status separately.

OBSERVATION (report, do not fix): dunning/retry route has a TODO — it records the attempt + billing event but does NOT actually call Stripe to retry the charge yet ('In a real implementation, this would trigger a background job'). The cap/attemptNumber logic (#1464) is real and testable; the actual re-charge is not wired. Plan should note this limits what 'failed payment -> dunning' can verify in test mode.

OBSERVATION (report, do not fix): non-USD currency. Razorpay pricing is in paise INR (integer, lib/razorpay.ts RAZORPAY_PLAN_PRICING). billingEvents currency is hard-coded 'usd' in upgrade/dunning routes; service_subscriptions.currency defaults 'USD'. Integer-cents math lives in lib/money.ts (decimal-string domain, 2dp) and lib/billing/payments.ts (toCents). Stripe amounts are cents. The non-USD check should use Razorpay INR paise as the integer-minor-unit example.
